## 01 · Yellowdig Fetch Events
Returns one **source bundle** (schemas/source-bundle.schema.json).

- **fixture**: synthetic Week 2, no credential.
- **yellowdig**: official API. Attach the n8n credential **Yellowdig CIS 515** (Header Auth, header name `apikey`) to Capability Probe and Fetch Event Pages. Never put the key in a node parameter. Fails on 401/403.
- **auto**: Yellowdig when `yellowdigCredentialConfigured` is true, otherwise fixture with `fallbackReason`.

Code nodes are generated from `web/src/n8n/nodes/wf01.ts`. Do not edit them here.
Live Yellowdig access is **not verified** yet.

### Privacy boundary
Raw events exist only in the HTTP nodes and **Collect Pages and Minimize**. After that: pseudonymous ids, display names and post text only. No SIS ids, LTI fields, emails or raw user ids.

nodeGroups.name: Run configuration
nodeGroups.description: Validates the untrusted run input and picks fixture or Yellowdig with an explicit reason.

nodeGroups.name: Live fetch
nodeGroups.description: Capability check on a 10-event probe, then cursor pagination (max 250 per page, page limit).

nodeGroups.name: Failure handling
nodeGroups.description: Classifies HTTP failures: bounded retry for 429/5xx, fallback only in auto mode, otherwise fail.

nodeGroups.name: Post-fetch pipeline
nodeGroups.description: Privacy minimization, dedupe by event id, Phoenix date and topic filter, schema check.

observatory.note: Credentials, pinned data, webhook ids and instance metadata removed. Code nodes are generated; see web/scripts/build-n8n.ts.
